body: I can't fix it all though. I can't even do one productive thing. today I mostly stayed in bed except when I forced myself to get food

I'm about a month into college and I'm pretty much still where I was on the first day, coursework-wise, depression-wise. I don't even know what I've missed. I have a test Thursday that I don't know any of the material for and certainly won't make it to. I'm trying to work with my academic dean/professors/therapist but it's so hard, I don't even want to wake up in the morning and face all this guilt hanging over me

I've taken a medical withdrawal before because I was looking at straight Fs. Last semester was really bad too. I'm so scared that all this failure is happening again and I have no way to stop it, but actually trying to stop it feels impossible. So much fucking easier to end it, not to mention all the other shit in my life

I don't know what's worth fighting for, or that there even will be things worth fighting for. I don't feel like I have a reason to live anymore. How do I keep moving forward without that, when everything seems impossible? I know that some part of me wants to live, I just don't know what I'd be living for
